parameters.content: ## BLOCKING activation order: attach the GUI basic-auth credential to all 7 webhook routes FIRST, set the real noVNC URL in GUI/State configs, then activate. Webhook routes bypass Cloudflare Access by design — n8n auth must be live before this serves traffic. Collector workflow stays inactive.

versionMetadata.description: Independent review found that POST /dry-run's fire-and-forget response means a Stop click right after Run can race ahead of the collector actually starting, so server.js reports "nothing to stop" while the run proceeds unaffected. Fixed by auto-retrying the stop request for up to 20s after Run is clicked, and by distinguishing a genuinely-unreachable collector (undefined ok) from an explicit "not running" (ok: false).
versionMetadata.name: Fix Stop-button race window
